name: Global camera and mic toggles
plain: System switches that turn the camera or mic off for all apps.
meaning: A blank feed for the camera and silence for the mic. Android 12 only; support depends on the device.

android.note: Camera shows blank frames; mic returns silence and motion sensors are rate-limited; emergency calls re-enable mic. Device dependent.

ios.note: iOS has no global toggle; MDM can disable the camera.

limits.headline: Can show you a blank camera and silence when you flip a phone wide switch
limits.user_action: You switch off Camera access or Mic access in Quick Settings
can: Give blank frames from the camera when the switch is off (Android 12)
Slow down motion sensors on some phones
cannot: Work on iPhone; there is no global switch there (a company can block the camera)
Work on every Android phone; it depends on the maker
Block emergency calls; the mic comes back for them
limits.differs: Android 12 and later, on some devices. iPhone has none.

story.what_it_is: System switches that turn the camera or microphone off for every app at once.

marketing.name: Camera and microphone toggles
marketing.pitch: Quick Settings tiles turn camera and mic access off for all apps.

story.for_you: You pull down Quick Settings and flip 'Camera access' or 'Mic access' off. All apps then see a black picture or silence.
story.for_makers: It gives people a hard stop that an app cannot bypass. Makers must handle blank feeds gracefully and tell users to turn the toggle on when a feature needs it.

use_cases.example: A video call app shows a black screen and a hint to turn the camera toggle back on.
A voice chat game shows 'mic is off' and lets you play without voice.
A camera filter app asks you to enable camera access in Quick Settings.
A privacy minded person leaves the mic off until a call starts.
A work phone policy locks both toggles off in secure rooms.
A voice command app warns that voice control is silent when the mic toggle is off.

risks: Easy to forget it is off
story.android_note: Android 12 and later, with support depending on the phone maker.
story.ios_note: iOS has no global camera toggle, but Control Center and Settings give per app control.

history.change: Global mic and camera toggles introduced
